AssemblyAI-STT-3.7 supports 32 languages: AssemblyAI-STT-3.7 supports 32 languages; with automatic language detection, a language it does not support goes to Universal-2. Universal-2 offers 37 languages and always uses the async API, at $0.15/h, without the modes below.
Live streams dictations with a live prev: Live streams dictations with a live preview, and the text is ready right after you stop; billed while the connection is open. Recordings, files and dictations without a preview then use the Sync API. Sync uploads the recording when you stop and usually finishes in under half a second. Dictation uploads dictations when you stop and returns them cleaned up by Universal-3.6 Pro: filler words removed, punctuation and capitalization fixed. Recordings and files are not cleaned up; they use the Sync API. Dictations over 20 minutes, with more than 100 dictionary terms or in a language it doesn't support, and failed requests use the async API without cleanup. Async costs the least but takes a few seconds. Only Live shows a live preview from AssemblyAI, and speaker diarization always uses the async API. With more than 100 dictionary terms, Live also transcribes the recording, billed in addition. AssemblyAI list prices in November 2026; add-ons such as dictionary terms cost extra.
Realtime-Agent keeps the preview steady: Realtime-Agent keeps the preview steady as you speak. Realtime costs less, but the preview changes more while you speak. The final text is as accurate.
Label speakers in recordings, files, wat: Label speakers in recordings, files, watch folders and the HTTP API, with utterance timestamps. Uses the async API; dictations are not labeled and then show no live preview from AssemblyAI.
Verify the entered key without uploading: Verify the entered key without uploading audio or saving changes.
